title: List deployment runs
summary: List every attempt to trigger a deployment, newest first, optionally narrowed to one deployment, to the runs that failed, or by trigger kind.

parameters.name: deployment_id
parameters.description: Only runs of this deployment. Omitted, every run is returned.

parameters.name: has_error
parameters.description: `true` returns only runs that recorded an error, `false` only runs that did not. Any other value is refused by name.

parameters.name: trigger_type
parameters.description: Only runs of this trigger kind.

parameters.name: created_at[gt|gte|lt|lte]
parameters.description: ISO 8601 bounds on when the run started.

title: Get deployment run
summary: Retrieve one deployment run by the id a `deployment_run` event carries in `data.id`.

response.name: deployment_id
response.description: Deployment this run attempted to trigger.

response.name: session_id
response.description: Session the run created, or null when it failed before one existed.

response.name: error
response.description: Classified `{type, message}` on a failed run — `environment_archived_error`, `session_creation_rejected_error`, `vault_not_found_error`, `file_not_found_error`, `memory_store_archived_error`, `unknown_error`, and friends — and null on a successful one.

response.name: agent
response.description: `{type, id, version}`. Taken from the session the run created, so it is the agent that ran. On a failed run `version` is the deployment’s pinned version or null, and `id` is the deployment’s agent.

response.name: trigger_context
response.description: `{type}` is `schedule` for a timed run — with `scheduled_at` naming the cron instant it answered — and `manual` for a hand-triggered one.
